name: Vastra
description: B2B textile marketplace with a retrieval-grounded AI assistant (local embeddings + Groq LLM). React, Express, MongoDB.

paragraphs: Vastra is a B2B textile marketplace. Buyers (boutiques, garment makers, retailers) can source fabric straight from Indian mills and wholesalers. A retrieval-grounded AI assistant answers questions using the live product catalog. Built with React, Express and MongoDB. Embeddings come from a sentence-transformer model that runs inside the server, and replies come from an LLM on Groq's free tier. Both are free to run.
The API runs on Render's free tier, so the first request after a quiet period can take a while as the server wakes up.
features: Browse without an account. The catalog offers keyword search, category filters and sorting, plus an AI search mode that ranks fabrics by meaning (for example, "breathable fabric for summer kurtas").
Product pages show specs, minimum order quantity, bulk price tiers, stock, buyer reviews, similar fabrics found through embeddings, and a link to the supplier's storefront.
The cart enforces each product's minimum order and available stock. A guest cart is merged into the account cart when the buyer signs in.
Checkout reprices everything on the server, reserves stock atomically and creates one order per supplier. No payment is taken in the app; suppliers arrange invoicing directly.
Bulk quote requests: ask a supplier for a price on a large quantity. Accepting the offer puts it in the cart at the negotiated price.

requirements.text: For the assistant's replies you also need a free Groq API key.
Guest-cart items that fail a stock or MOQ check at sign-in are skipped without a message.
